merced: merced — mercy, favor, grace (noun; Merced, Campeador 'mercy, thanks, Campeador', the word of a suppliant or of thanks; = merced)
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront')
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it')
conssejo: conssejo — help, remedy (spelling variant of consejo; Pidal 'amparo, socorro'; = consejo) · also conssejo — council, deliberation (fablando en so conssejo 'talking in their council'; = consejo)
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
queremos: querer — we wish, we want (present 1st pl.)
fer: fazer — to do, make (short infinitive form; = hacer; fer lo he = lo haré, split future)
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison)
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué)
del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
casar: casar — to marry off, to be married (infinitive; por casar son vuestras fijas 'your daughters are to be married'; por + inf. 'still to be done'; = casar)
ellas: ella — they, them (fem. pl., stressed; con ellas 'with them'; = ellas)
su: su — his, her, its · also su — their (aquella su almofalla 'that host of theirs')
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing' · also pro — profit, advantage, benefit (grant pro les fazié 'he did them great good, was of great profit to them')
una: uno/una — one, a (fem.) · also a una — together, as one (adverbial; hivan a una compaña 'they went together'; a una grant ondrança 'together with great honor'; = juntos)
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora)
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
penssó: pensar — he set about (preterite 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; = pensó)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment')
tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón)
mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss')
sis: si + se — if … themselves (conjunction si + reflexive se; que sis pudiessen ir 'that if they could go away'; = si se)
abrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., b for v; de lo nuestro abrá 'he will have of ours'; = habrá)
sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid')
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
queredes: querer — you wish (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = queréis)
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación)
minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
per: Per — Pero, short for Pedro (Per Vermudoz = Pedro Bermúdez, a vassal of the Cid)
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
alfonsso: Alfonsso — Alfonso (VI, king of León and Castile)
essora: essora — then, at that moment (ess' + ora; en essora 'at that moment'; = entonces)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le])
oídme: oír + me — hear me (imperative 2nd pl. oíd + enclitic me; = oídme)
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
mereçe: merecer — he deserves, earns (present 3rd sg.; el que mereçe la soldada 'he who earns his pay'; = merece)
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda)
oviesse: aver — he had, he might have (imperfect subjunctive of aver; = hubiese)
dent: dent — of it, thereof (de + ent, a form of ende 'thence'; non nos darán dent nada 'they will give us none of it'; = de ello) · also dent — from there, thence (dent corre mio Çid a Huesa 'from there the Çid raids to Huesa'; = de allí)
mandados: mandado — message, news, report (pl.; here the tidings that spread; = mandados)
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
mi: mi — my (unstressed possessive) · also mi — me (stressed pronoun after a preposition; por mi 'on my behalf'; = mí)
cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte)
iffantes: infante — child, young child (pl., spelt with ff; = niños); also a young man of noble birth
carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán) · also han a + inf. 'they have to, are bound to' (mandado de so señor todo lo han a far); 'they hold, possess' (que moros las han) · also perfect auxiliary 'have' with a participle agreeing with its object (la ganançia que han fecha 'the booty they have made')
amas: amos — both (fem. pl., Latin ambas; las manos amas 'both hands'; = ambas)
dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran)
gelo: ge + lo — it to him/them (ge, ancestor of modern se, + lo; = se lo)
digades: dezir — (that) you say, tell (2nd pl. present subjunctive used as command, polite; digades al conde 'tell the count'; = digáis)
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings')
fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
plogo: plazer — it pleased (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = plugo, modern plació)
rogar: rogar — to pray (infinitive; ayude a rogar 'help (me) to pray'; = rogar)
emos: aver — we have (present 1st pl., hemos without the h; = hemos); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (partir nos emos = nos partiremos)
después: después — afterward, then · also después que — since, seeing that (causal; después que de moros fo 'since it came from Moors')
faga: fazer — may I/he make, cause (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = haga); faga cantar 'have sung'
dezid: dezir — say, tell (imperative 2nd pl.; Dezid al Canpeador 'tell the Campeador'; = decid)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
naçió: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le) · that ... to him (quel creçe conpaña 'that company grows for him')
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain) · also dar — I give (present 1st sg.; d'aquí vos do mi graçia 'from here I give you my favor'; = doy) · also do — for don, 'lord' (title before a name; el obispo do Jero[me] 'the bishop don Jerome')
aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado) · also ready, prepared (ser + part., impersonal: Ya es aguisado 'now all is arranged')
fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him') · also le — dative of separation, 'from him' (que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'); dative 'for him' (ques le non spidiés 'who does not take leave of him')
tornados: tornar — turned back, returned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with los 'them'; a los moros dentro los an tornados 'they have put the Moors back inside'; = vueltos, devueltos)
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing') · also ir + infinitive 'go to' (le van çercar 'they go to besiege him'; se van tornar 'they go back')
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
sopo: saber — he learned, found out (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = supo)
sonrrisós: sonrreír + se — he smiled (sonrrisó + -s(e); = sonrrisóse, -se reduced to -s after a stressed vowel)
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
pocas: poco — few (fem. pl.; pocas de gentes 'few people'; = pocas)
tales: tal — such (pl., both genders; tales malcalçados 'such ill-shod men'; = tales)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
saludes: salud — greeting; news of an absent person (pl.; Pidal: saludes 'noticias de una persona ausente'; diziéndoles saludes de primos 'bringing them news of their cousins'; = saludos, noticias)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
coraçón: coraçón — heart (= corazón) · also por coraçón 'willingly, heartily, with a will' (lo an por coraçón) · also de coraçón 'heartily, with a will' (adóbanse de coraçón 'they arm with a will')
amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of'
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
diziendo: dezir — saying (gerund; diziendo Minaya 'Minaya says', the gerund standing for a finite verb of speech; = diciendo)
dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses' · also dar — to give way, yield (oviéronse a dar 'they had to give way'; = ceder, rendirse)
sues: su — his, her (fem. pl. possessive, old sue/sues; = sus)
ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
echado: echar — cast out, exiled (past part.; = echado)
he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he)
afán: afán — toil, hardship, labor (masc. noun; con afán gané 'with toil I won'; = afán)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
semeja: semejar — it seems, appears (present 3rd sg.; = parece)
ploguiere: plazer — (as long as) it may please (future subjunctive 3rd sg., strong; mientra ploguiere al Padre 'as long as it please the Father'; si vos ploguiere 'if it please you'; = pluguiere)
esso: esso — that (neuter demonstrative; esso con esto 'that together with this'; = eso)
mucho: mucho — much, greatly · also mucho — very, intensifying a predicate (mucho es mañana 'it is much too early, too soon') · also mas mucho — 'more' (mucho as a comparative = más: mas mucho fue provechosa 'was more profitable'; Pidal)
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do' · also future auxiliary after an infinitive, the split future (ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán)
part: part — share, portion (noun; = parte) · also part — side (del otra part 'on the other side'; = parte)
deste: de + este — of this, from this (contraction; deste pan 'of this bread', partitive 'some of'; = de este)
más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more' · also más por espacio — 'later, at more leisure' (más 'further'; por espacio 'in good time')
vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale) · also va + le — 'it goes on (…ing) for him' (ir + gerund with enclitic le: Yal creçe la barba e vale allongando 'and it goes on lengthening for him'; = se le va alargando) · also más vale que 'it is better that' (impersonal; más vale que nos los vezcamos 'better that we conquer them')
ello: ello — it (neuter pronoun; de ello 'of it'; = ello)
poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence' · also poridad — secret council, secret plan (aviendo su poridad 'holding their secret talk'; con esta poridad 'with this secret plan')
mijor: mejor — better (Latin melior, spelled mijor; mijor me sirve que vos 'he serves me better than you'; = mejor)
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
querer: querer — to want, wish (infinitive; head of the split future querer m'a = me querrá, 'he will want me')
veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables) · also to review, inspect (troops) (mandó ve[e]r sus yentes 'had his men mustered'; Pidal: 'revistar') · also ir veer 'to go and attack' (iremos ve[e]r aquella su almofalla; Pidal 'atacaremos aquel su ejército')
darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos)
acordar: acordar — to take counsel, agree (infinitive; tornós a acordar 'he set to take counsel'; = acordar) · 'to bring (him) round, persuade' (nol pueden acordar 'they cannot persuade him')
mejor: mejor — better, best (adverb; quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she knows how'; = mejor) · also mejor — better (adjective; oy es día bueno e mejor será cras 'today is a good day and tomorrow will be better')
plazme: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me; = me place)
ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
buscar: buscar — to seek (infinitive; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us', infinitive + clitic + auxiliary, split future/conditional; = buscar)
quisiere: querer — shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiere)
queramos: querer — we may wish (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que nos queramos ir 'if we should want to go', que + subjunctive as a condition; = queramos)
sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer') · also sobre — 'besides, in addition to' (Sobre aquesto todo 'on top of all this')
mayor: mayor — larger, greater (aquella mayor az 'that greatest line'; = mayor) · also Mayor — part of the place name Mont Mayor, Montemayor (the Portuguese town, Pidal)
quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere) · also 'is about to' (el março quiere entrar 'March is about to come in')
enbió: enviar — he sent (preterite 3rd sg.; enbió pora allá 'he sent (messengers) over there'; = envió)
ferá: fazer — it will do, will fare (syncopated future 3rd sg. of fazer; assí ferá lo de Siloca 'so too will it be with the Siloca (country)'; = hará)
